sources.entry: Whisky - A tool for running Windows apps on macOS, built with SwiftUI and supporting D3DMetal and DXVK backends. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon] ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]](https://github.com/frankea/Whisky)

Whisky - Native SwiftUI Wine wrapper for macOS with D3DMetal/DXVK backends and built-in launcher compatibility (Steam, Epic, EA App, Battle.net). Active community fork of the archived whisky-app/whisky.

summary.one_liner: Whisky is a community-maintained, native SwiftUI graphical wrapper for Wine that lets Apple Silicon Macs run Windows apps and games in managed "bottles."
summary.what_it_does: Provides a GUI for creating and managing Wine bottles (isolated Windows environments) on macOS, so users can install and run Windows apps and games without manual Wine configuration. The README lists Wine 11.0 as the bundled runtime, with DXMT (DirectX 11 to Metal) as the default graphics path and DXVK over MoltenVK as a fallback; D3DMetal is also named in the backends. It includes built-in launcher compatibility for Steam, Epic, EA App, Rockstar and Battle.net, plus SDL environment variable controls for gamepad issues. A one-click diagnostic report is offered for crashes and freezes, and a "Game Configurations" set of 80+ per-game configs is browsable in-app. Migration from the archived original Whisky app is supported via File → Migrate, and updates are delivered through Sparkle. Telemetry is opt-in and off by default.
use_cases: run Windows games on a Mac
install and run Windows apps on macOS
play Steam or Epic games on Apple Silicon Mac
manage Wine bottles through a graphical interface
troubleshoot Windows game crashes and controller issues on Mac
migrate bottles from the original Whisky app
how_to_run: Or download the latest Whisky-X.Y.Z.dmg from the releases page and drag Whisky.app to /Applications
Launch Whisky; on first run it downloads the Wine runtime (~330 MB) and creates a default bottle
notable: Community fork continuing development after the original whisky-app/whisky was archived in April 2025
Native SwiftUI macOS interface with one-click bottle creation
Migration path from the original Whisky app that references existing bottles in place
Opt-in, off-by-default anonymous telemetry with a documented list of five events
Curated library of 80+ per-game compatibility configurations
caveats: Requires Apple Silicon (M-series) CPU and macOS Sequoia 15.0 or later
Maintained by a single maintainer, as the README's support and bus-factor sections acknowledge
Not affiliated with the original project; the default brew whisky cask still points to the archived original
